MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[0] AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[1] AS INT64) AS birth_month,
  CAST(split(p.birth_date, '/')[2] AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH p,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
WHERE (p.nationality = 'Slovenian' AND p.birth_date <> '1994/6/6')
   OR (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 AND age > 78)
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player

MATCH (p:Player)-[:MentionedIn]->(d:Document)
WITH DISTINCT p,
  CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^(\\d{4})/(\\d{1,2})/(\\d{1,2})$', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
  CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^(\\d{4})/(\\d{1,2})/(\\d{1,2})$', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
  CAST(regexp_extract(p.birth_date, '^(\\d{4})/(\\d{1,2})/(\\d{1,2})$', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH p,
  2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age,
  birth_year,
  birth_month,
  birth_day
WHERE (p.nationality = 'Slovenian' AND p.birth_date <> '1994/6/6')
   OR (CAST(p.nba_championships AS INT64) <= 2 AND age > 78)
RETURN p.nationality AS col1, p.birth_date AS col2, age AS col3, p.name AS name_player
